liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Brokedown Palace** (2 reviews): Reviewer says this show has the first Brokedown Palace; Reviewer says this is the first-ever Brokedown Palace [6][13]
- **Operator** (2 reviews): Reviewer says this show has the first Operator; Reviewer treasures this rare Operator despite imperfect sound [6][12]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer says this is the first-ever Truckin' [13]
- **Ripple** (1 review): Reviewer says this is the first-ever Ripple [13]
- Reviewer's favorite version, with a very bluesy, shredding jam reaching peaks other versions don't [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-08-18.142416.aud.knudsen.gems.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 131 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd70-08-18.aud.yerys.1346.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 137 min; rated 3.28/5 by 36 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience tape poor, as if recorded with a pocket recorder; Reviewer says the main flaw is boominess in the tape, fixable by equalizing problem frequencies; Reviewer rates this audience recording as excellent among early audience tapes [6][10][11][12][14]
- **gd1970-08-18.142417.aud.knudsen.gems.FIXED.flac2448**: audience recording; 24 songs; 131 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1970-08-18.141071.aud.pitch-adjusted.flac1644**: audience recording; 23 songs; 131 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- Article reflects on backstage at the Fillmore West, once a few murky closets and thin walls [17]
- After Truckin', there is a request to turn up the monitors [1]
- Later set includes Six Days On The Road, Glendale Train and Brown-Eyed Handsome Man [1]
- The show was split into an acoustic set followed by an electric set [4]
- Reviewer says this Man's World jam outdoes other versions, including the one from May 2, 1970 [7]
- Reviewer values it as rare early acoustic Dead material [9]
- Recommends the 9/17/70 show for an early acoustic Box of Rain missing from Deadbase [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-08-18.142416.aud.knudsen.gems.flac1648**: taped by From the Collection of Jeff Knudsen; transferred by Jason Chastain and Jamie Waddell and John Wenzel and Tom Markson; source: flac16/48kHz ; Unknown Audience Cassette > FLAC [1]
- **gd70-08-18.aud.yerys.1346.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Miles Garret, Jared Minkoff, Ben Yerys; source: Audience [4]. Also: Reviewer calls it one of the earliest audience tapes of the Dead; Audience recording by Yerys, circulated as a shn file [4][9]
- **gd1970-08-18.142417.aud.knudsen.gems.FIXED.flac2448**: taped by From the Collection of Jeff Knudsen; transferred by Jason Chastain and Jamie Waddell and John Wenzel and Tom Markson; source: Unknown Audience Cassette > FLAC [2]
- **gd1970-08-18.141071.aud.pitch-adjusted.flac1644**: transferred by syncopatico; source: AUD mC> Rx2> DAT> CDR; this new version has been pitch adjusted with the following ratios: acoustic set with a 'slight' sliding time scale/pitch shift of… [3]
